producer_report.summary:
I moved the Records-branch writes row from gh/mod.rs into the new gh/records.rs, with the text unchanged. That covers LandingRecords, LandingFacts, verification_id, history_method, GitLandingRecords and its impls, CutoverRun, cutover_job_for, run_cutover, cutover_catch_up, the ReconcileRecords impl and the INTENT_DIR, LANDING_DIR and DECLARED_DIR constants. gh/mod.rs now has `mod records;` and re-exports the public names, so every gh:: path is as before. I removed the imports mod.rs no longer uses and added import lines to the tests module. Besides imports, one line changed: `GitLandingRecords::commits` is now `pub(super)`, because a test left in mod.rs calls it. The CHANGELOG has a G4 entry. fmt, clippy, the 75 gh:: tests and the policy scan pass; I did not run the full suite.

Caller check, a Grep over crates/ excluding gh/ for all the moved names, with the file and the match count in it:
- reconcile.rs: 12 matches.
- test_support.rs: 3.
- land.rs (`verification_id`): 2.
- status.rs, commits.rs, run/mod.rs and auditor.rs (`cutover_job_for`): 1 each.
- crates/athena-cli/tests/cutover_fixture.rs (`cutover_job_for`): 4.
- crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs: 2.

No `gh::records` path appears anywhere. Callers use the gh:: re-exports.

reconcile.rs needed no edit.

checks_run.note: 75 gh tests pass; full suite not run (left to Athena)

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/gh/records.rs exists and contains LandingRecords, LandingFacts, verification_id, history_method, GitLandingRecords and its impls, CutoverRun, cutover_job_for, run_cutover, cutover_catch_up and the ReconcileRecords impl; none of these definitions remain in gh/mod.rs (Grep fn/struct/trait definitions in both files).
criteria_check.evidence: Wrote records.rs with all of them (text copied from mod.rs lines 839-1259); removed the same block from mod.rs with Edit. Cargo check shows no duplicate definitions.

criteria_check.criterion: gh/mod.rs declares the records module and re-exports every public moved name with pub use, so Grep of `gh::(LandingRecords|GitLandingRecords|LandingFacts|cutover)` across crates/ is unchanged and no caller outside gh/ uses gh::records:: paths.
criteria_check.evidence: mod.rs has `mod records;` and `pub use records::{CutoverRun, GitLandingRecords, LandingFacts, LandingRecords, cutover_catch_up, cutover_job_for, verification_id}`. Grep for `gh::records` across crates/ finds nothing. Outside callers compile unchanged (clippy --all-targets passes).

criteria_check.criterion: git diff shows the moved text is identical to the removed text (apart from added module doc, imports, mod and pub use lines), and no test function is added, removed, renamed, or edited beyond import lines.
criteria_check.evidence: Text copied verbatim. Other edits: module doc and imports in records.rs, trimmed imports and the added mod/pub use in mod.rs, and test-module import lines in mod.rs. One non-import change: `GitLandingRecords::commits` became `pub(super)`, because a test left in mod.rs calls it. 75 gh:: tests pass.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a G4 entry under Unreleased stating the Records-branch writes row moved and behavior is unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: Added a 'Structure pass job G4' bullet under Unreleased > Changed in CHANGELOG.md.

criteria_check.criterion: The final report lists the caller check (a Grep result) for each moved name; the verifier can rerun those Greps over crates/.
criteria_check.evidence: Caller check is in the summary. Outside gh/, with glob !**/gh/**, the names occur in reconcile.rs (12), status.rs, commits.rs, land.rs, run/mod.rs, auditor.rs, test_support.rs, and athena-cli tests reconcile.rs and cutover_fixture.rs. All use `gh::` paths, and none uses `gh::records`.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked: all pass, and the number of tests run equals the count after G3 (1397).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full suite. I ran fmt --check and clippy (both pass) and the 75 gh:: tests (pass). No test was added or removed.

open_issues: Full `cargo test --locked` and the 1397 test count are left to Athena's checks.
mistakes: I first added ReconcileRecords and RecordsSnapshot to the test imports, though no test needs them; I removed them after check warned of unused imports.
learnings: Tests in gh/mod.rs use `super::*`, so they need explicit imports for the history types once those move out.
`GitLandingRecords::commits` is called from a test in mod.rs, so it needed `pub(super)`.
Bash allows no grep, so caller checks were done with the Grep tool.
